title: A Night Early
summary: When the peacekeepers rally around the player, Mira weighs bringing the cart before the gate is ready.

hooks.situation: Aldric talks about {player} the way he used to talk about Marcus. Men are sharpening tools at the gate. A cart that comes when it is expected is a cart they are ready for.

options.label: Send word up the trail: the cart comes a night early

effects.reason: The cart came a night early, before the men at the gate were ready for it.

effects.text: Weep a little with {player} over how little time is left, and learn what the gate is planning.

options.label: Keep the night, and give Aldric a wrong hour to plan by

effects.text: The widow says the cart may come late this year. Tell {player} to rest while they can.

options.label: Let the night stand; see who fights
